tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B takes the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: "Why can't Zofia come to the party?"

B hears the question and builds the answer. After can, must and should the verb stays in its base form (no -s, no to). The blue tile "have to" changes: has to, had to, don't have to. A tile "not" means n't.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Last, swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Mustn't means no. Don't have to means you can choose.
